summary: The exact 103-file candidate and all permitted baseline files matched. Fixtures, production integration, reviewer binding, official Schema-loader integration and mutations, and concurrency passed. A9 metadata revalidation passed after the authorized root filing assignment was added. The mandatory fresh 31-mutant suite did not emit a completion report or exit after more than ten minutes, so 31/31 killed cannot be independently attested.

reviewer_binding_assessment.gate_integration: Binding failures are structural INVALID with exit 1 on the production validateTask path.

a8_closure_dispositions.reason: Fresh production negative cases rejected all fourteen substitution, identity, assignment, scope, mode and session attacks.
The fixture suite uses the official production loader and fresh integration/mutation suites reject malformed, missing, alternate, downgraded and fallback paths.

findings.failure: The mandatory fresh command remained running for more than ten minutes without stdout, a final BOOTSTRAP_MUTATIONS report, or an exit code; total=31, killed=31, survived=0 is NOT_VERIFIED.
findings.read_only_reproduction: Run node .codex/tests/run-bootstrap-mutation-tests.mjs from the product root and require exit 0 plus total=31, killed=31, survived=0. Do not substitute the R9 stored summary.
findings.impact: The Reviewer cannot independently attest that all declared production mutants are killed on the reviewed candidate.
findings.minimum_remediation: Obtain a completed fresh isolated 31/31 mutation report and Reviewer revalidation before Candidate Review GO.

residual_risks: Reviewer identity is procedural, not cryptographic.
